{"body":"# P2-S3 — gatebraid-validate repair: heuristic scope, markdown records, N2 re-validation completion

## Goal

Repair the two instrument defects `gatebraid-validate`'s first production
run exposed (friction #169, #170) and complete the N2 re-validation that
run left bounded: scope the placeholder heuristic to command and citation
fields so GraphQL inline-fragment spreads and notes-field id
abbreviations are classified as mentions, not elisions; add a
markdown-gate-record mode (`## gatebraid-metadata` extraction, the
ADR-0026 form) so all four gate records of any Slice are within the
validator's reach; then re-run the full N2 re-validation to completion
and record it — discharging the remainder the P2-S2 closure named as
owed. Files under repair: `bin/gatebraid-validate.py` and
`bin/gatebraid-validate-selftest.py` (the ratified names; no new tool,
no new name).

## Context

- Why now: the P2-S2 closure's bounded discharge (issue #10, the Closure
  Resume's verbatim passage) leaves the full mechanical re-validation of
  N2's four gate records owed until this Slice lands; O1 will rely on
  the validator over real records, so the over-match is repaired before
  the toolchain is leaned on.
- Both repairs carry their falsifications: the heuristic fix is seeded
  in both directions (a genuine elision must still reject — the
  P2-S2-closure falsification pair is the model); the markdown mode is
  seeded with a valid and an invalid embedded record.
- Non-goals: no change to `bin/gatebraid-capture*.py` (never read, only
  executed); no contract, schema, ADR, template or corpus text; no edit
  to any merged historical gate record — `gate0.json`'s nine #171-class
  citations stay recorded, not repaired.
- Related: Phase P2 `#7` · P2-S1 `#8` · P2-S2 `#10` · PR `#11` ·
  friction #169/#170/#171 · the P2-S2 Closure Resume rulings (a)–(c).

## Acceptance

- [ ] The 11 P2-S1 captures rejected at the P2-S2 closure validate
      `accepted` with the repaired heuristic, AND a genuinely elided
      capture still rejects — both shown by seeded runs, summaries
      emitted by the instrument itself.
- [ ] All four P2-S1 gate records (`gate0.json`, `gate1.md`, `gate2.md`,
      `gate3.md`) are read and verdicts emitted by the validator's own
      record mode; `gate0.json`'s nine genuine findings reproduce
      (they are the record's, not the tool's).
- [ ] The full N2 re-validation re-runs to completion on the declared
      platforms and its results are recorded in this Slice's evidence —
      the P2-S2 closure's owed remainder, discharged.
- [ ] The selftest covers both repairs and is green on both platforms;
      the frozen corpus digest is unmoved before and after.
